import re, json, html
data = open("paths_page.html", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
# GitHub embeds raw file in a script tag with type="application/json" and id containing "data"
# Try to find the JSON payload
m = re.search(r'<script[^>]*type="application/json"[^>]*data-target="react-app.embedBody"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>', data, re.S)
if m:
    payload = json.loads(m.group(1))
    print("payload keys:", list(payload.keys()))
    raw = payload.get("rawLines") or payload.get("rawData")
    print(type(raw), len(raw) if raw else 0)
    if raw:
        content = "\n".join(raw) if isinstance(raw, list) else raw
        open("paths_2025.json","w").write(content)
        print(content[:500])
else:
    print("no react-app.embedBody found")
    # fallback: find any large json script
    for mm in re.finditer(r'<script[^>]*type="application/json"[^>]*>', data):
        print(mm.group(0)[:150])
